name: html-button-inherited-body-foreground-fills-missing-text-color
description: A filled button with no authored color of its own carries its inherited body foreground onto native style.color.text instead of falling through to the theme's white .wp-element-button default. A sibling button whose fill already authors white text (matching that same theme default) is unaffected.

source_reference.notes: Regression fixture for the light-background/dark-source-text button pair proven on a real import: a control-surface button (background only, color inherited from body) sat beside a primary button (background + explicit white text). Only the first lost its label to the theme default.

legacy_comparison.reason: Inherited native-button foreground resolution has no legacy equivalent.
